essence: The instruction is obligatory in every age, including the Kali age.
The text specifies a dark fivefold set of colors produced from bilva and similar leaves.
The Sarvatobhadra diagram is considered the common one to be employed in sequence.
The declared practice bestows all prosperity.
After giving the fee, one should perform a great festival.
